NixOS

sessiond is not officially supported on NixOS and requires additional manual configuration. NixOS is deeply integrated with logind, which sessiond replaces, so some system components may continue to depend on logind and need separate adjustment.

Install the module

Choose your prefered way of pinning the source.

Flakes

Add the input to your flake and import its module in your NixOS configuration:

{
  inputs.sessiond.url = "git+https://tangled.org/r0chd.pl/sessiond";

  outputs = { self, nixpkgs, sessiond, ... }: {
    nixosConfigurations.myHost = nixpkgs.lib.nixosSystem {
      modules = [
        ./configuration.nix
        sessiond.nixosModules.default
        { services.sessiond.enable = true; }
      ];
    };
  };
}

npins

npins add git --name sessiond https://tangled.org/r0chd.pl/sessiond --branch master
let
  sources = import ./npins;
  sessiond = import sources.sessiond.outPath { };
in
{
  imports = [ sessiond.nixosModules.default ];
  services.sessiond.enable = true;
}

Using sessiond in place of logind

Enabling the module does not disable logind. Running both services causes conflicts, each attempts to move the session leader process, such as a greeter, into its own cgroup. Moving the process out of the other service's cgroup disrupts its session tracking. Disable logind when using sessiond.

{ pkgs, ... }:
{
  services.logind.enable = false;
}

This keeps systemd as the system service manager but removes ability for systemd to manage user services. You also lose ability to view systemd service status without root permissions

PAM integration

The module starts the daemon but does not add the PAM session rule. To register console logins, configure the login PAM service:

{ config, ... }:
{
  security.pam.services.login.rules.session.sessiond = {
    control = "optional";
    modulePath = "${config.services.sessiond.package}/lib/security/pam_sessiond.so";
    order = 900;
  };
}

For other login paths, add the rule to the corresponding PAM service as well. Configuring login alone does not configure a display manager or SSH.

Known issues

The following problems remain unresolved in this setup.

greetd greeter

The greetd greeter fails to start, leaving a black screen. The cause has not yet been identified.

Switching configurations

switch-to-configuration does not currently work with this setup for two reasons:

  • It uses logind to list active users.
  • It relies on per-user systemd service managers to start nixos-activation.service.

Both dependencies need to be addressed for configuration switching to work with sessiond in place of logind.

For now, use nixos-rebuild boot instead of nixos-rebuild switch to build the configuration and make it the default for the next boot, then reboot to apply it. Include your usual flake or configuration arguments:

sudo nixos-rebuild boot --flake .#myHost
sudo reboot
